title: 第21章 上书殿 密谈第22章 神捕司
slug: 开局六连抽创建万古帝朝
content_zh:
大宗正萧玉虎气定神闲地站在一旁，
目光却紧紧锁定着正在向龙椅边殷勤伺候的老太监冯大伴。
只见他微微眯起双眸，向着自己的亲哥哥——当今圣上萧玉龙眨了眨眼。
而坐在龙椅之上的萧玉龙则满脸无奈之色，
轻轻叹息一声后说道：“冯大伴！你在朕身旁伺候也有些时间，也着实辛苦了。
今儿个暂且下去好生歇息一番吧！”
老太监冯大伴自然是个机灵之人，闻得此言，赶忙恭恭敬敬地朝着自家陛下萧玉龙深深施了一礼，
然后，应声道：“多谢陛下体恤，那奴才这便先行告退了。
若陛下有何事需要吩咐，尽管传唤奴才便是。”
言罢，
他便轻手轻脚、迈着细碎的小步子，小心翼翼地退出了上书殿。
待到老太监冯大伴的身影彻底消失在上书殿内之后，
整个大殿瞬间变得安静下来。
此时，
大宗正萧玉虎再也按捺不住心中的怒火，愤愤不平地开口道：
“皇兄！微臣今日可是听闻一桩惊人之事，说是我那六侄子萧凡竟然遭人设计陷害而下毒啦！
如今这等消息已然如同长了翅膀一般，迅速传遍了咱们这偌大的都城了！”
“六侄子萧凡可是咱们大萧皇朝的一面旗帜，
他不但是咱大萧皇朝里年轻一代中最具天赋之人，更是当之无愧的翘楚之首。
就连咱们萧氏皇族祖地中的那帮老家伙们，也将他视作心肝宝贝一般。

可以毫不夸张地说，
这小子将来必定会成为近乎百分之百的神话级别洞天境大能，
而且绝非普通的大能可比。
他就是咱们萧氏皇族未来的强大底蕴的种子，
承载着整个皇族的荣耀继续下去的责任。”
“想一想如今的局势吧！
估计各方势力，尤其是那些平日里上蹿下跳、闹腾得厉害的世家大族们，正眼巴巴地瞅着咱们萧氏皇族呢？就等着看咱们的笑话。
说不定他们就是想借着这次机会，好好试探一番咱们萧氏皇族的底线究竟在哪里。”
皇帝萧玉龙面色沉静如水，缓缓说道：
“没错，咱们大萧皇朝自建立至今，已然历经了超过三千多年的风风雨雨。
在这片广袤的土地上，
各种各样大大小小的势力、门派以及世家如雨后春笋般不断涌现出来，不断地发展壮大。
时间一长，
有些人便开始有些自我膨胀起来了，心中也就滋生出了那不该有的念头。”
大宗正萧玉虎听闻此言，顿时怒发冲冠，那张原本就有些凶悍的脸庞此刻更是因为愤怒而涨得通红，他瞪大双眼，满脸愤懑之色，高声吼道：
“皇兄！此事绝对不能善罢甘休！要不让臣弟亲自带领一队精兵强将，趁着这次六侄子遭人下毒之事，狠狠地灭掉他们一两个世家，
也好让这天下之人都瞧瞧，咱们萧氏皇族的威严岂容他人轻易冒犯，我等皇室之虎须又岂是那些宵小之辈能够随意触碰的！”
然而，
坐在龙椅之上的皇帝萧玉龙却是轻轻地摇了摇头，一脸无奈地叹息道：“大宗正！你这火爆的脾气何时才能收敛一些呢？若总是这般冲动行事，怕是会给我们带来不少麻烦！”
content_en:
Da Zongzheng Xiao Yuhu stood aside calmly,
However, his eyes were firmly fixed on the old eunuch Feng Daban who was waiting diligently beside the dragon chair.
He narrowed his eyes slightly and blinked at his brother, the current Holy Lord Xiao Yulong.
Xiao Yulong, who was sitting on the dragon chair, had a look of helplessness on his face.
After sighing softly, he said: "Feng Daban! You have been waiting by my side for some time, and it is really hard.
Let’s go down and have a good rest today! "
The old eunuch Feng Daban was naturally a smart man. After hearing this, he quickly and respectfully bowed deeply to his Majesty Xiao Yulong.
Then, he responded: "Thank you for your consideration, Your Majesty, that servant will take his leave now.
If Your Majesty needs any instructions, just summon your servants. "
Say it,
He then walked quietly and cautiously out of the Shangshu Hall with tiny steps.
After the figure of the old eunuch Feng Daban completely disappeared from the Shangshu Hall,
The entire hall instantly became quiet.
At this time,
Da Zongzheng Xiao Yuhu could no longer suppress the anger in his heart and said angrily:
"Brother Imperial! I heard something shocking today, saying that my sixth nephew Xiao Fan was framed and poisoned!
Now this news has spread quickly throughout our huge capital city as if it has grown wings! "
"Sixth nephew Xiao Fan is a flag of our Great Xiao Dynasty.
He is not only the most talented person among the younger generation in our Great Xiao Dynasty, but also the well-deserved leader.
Even the old guys in our Xiao family's ancestral land regard him as their darling.
It is no exaggeration to say,
This kid will definitely become a nearly 100% mythical level Cave Heaven Realm expert in the future.
And it is definitely not comparable to ordinary powers.
He is the seed of the strong future of our Xiao royal family.
Carrying the responsibility of continuing the glory of the entire royal family. "
“Think about the current situation!
It is estimated that all forces, especially those wealthy families who usually jump up and down and make a lot of noise, are looking at our Xiao royal family eagerly? Just wait and see our jokes.
Maybe they just want to take this opportunity to test the bottom line of our Xiao royal family. "
Emperor Xiao Yulong's face was as calm as water, and he said slowly:
"Yes, our Great Xiao Dynasty has gone through more than three thousand years of ups and downs since its establishment.
In this vast land,
Various large and small forces, sects, and aristocratic families have sprung up like mushrooms after a rain, and continue to grow and develop.
As time goes by,
Some people begin to feel a little self-inflated, and thoughts that they shouldn't have arise in their hearts. "
When Da Zongzheng Xiao Yuhu heard this, he was immediately furious. His originally fierce face was even redder with anger. He widened his eyes, his face full of anger, and shouted loudly:
"Brother Imperial! This matter must not be let go! Why don't I let my brother personally lead a team of elite soldiers and take advantage of the poisoning of the sixth nephew to ruthlessly destroy one or two of their aristocratic families?
Let everyone in the world see how the majesty of our Xiao family can be easily offended by others, and how can the tiger beards of our royal family be touched by the young people at will! "
However,
Emperor Xiao Yulong, who was sitting on the dragon chair, shook his head gently and sighed helplessly: "Da Zongzheng! When will your fiery temper be controlled? If you always act so impulsively, I'm afraid it will bring us a lot of trouble!"
